test_title: PYST 54: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the appropriate option that can substitute the underlined word in the following sentence to make it grammatically correct.

She is the most active and __the more__ energetic social worker in our team.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. the most .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence mentions two qualities about the subject: being active and energetic. When comparing the subject to others, the use of superlative adjectives is appropriate.
 
• The word **"more"** is used for comparative degree, but since the sentence already uses **"most active"** (superlative degree), the adjective **"energetic"** should also follow the superlative form.
 
• The correct substitution for **"more energetic"** is **"the most energetic"**.

Correct sentence: *She is the most active and the most energetic social worker in our team*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Superlative Degree:**
 
 
• **Structure:** The + adjective in superlative form.
 
• **Example:** She is the tallest girl in the class.
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare one entity to all others in a group.
 
 
 
• **Comparative Degree:**
 
 
• **Structure:** More + adjective (or adjective + -er).
 
• **Example:** She is more intelligent than her peers.
 
• **Usage:** Used to compare two entities.
